purpose: Three weapon moveset concept boards, not gameplay implementation

items.prompt:
Create one production-quality game combat design comparison board, a single coherent direction titled “利落招式”. Target dimensions 1440 x 1024 landscape. This is a visual design proposal, not a screenshot of a finished game. Use purposeful spacing and very readable Chinese labels. Off-white drawing-paper surface and subtle pale blue horizontal ground lines. A clear title and exactly four spacious areas in a 2 by 2 composition, separated only by thin pencil rules, not nested cards or software UI. No option numbers, no letters, no navigation, no footer clutter.
Use the attached girl's actual identity and crayon drawing style: black coarse round outlines, red triangular dress, two curled pigtails, smiling face, stick limbs. This SAME girl demonstrates every weapon, so visual comparisons are consistent. Adapt her arm and leg poses to each attack, never substitute a generic anime warrior. References 2 to 5 are the exact Tang dao, fire-tip spear, straight jian, and Chinese halberd shapes. Wind-fire wheels are small orange-gold crayon wheels beneath the feet. Keep weapon silhouettes and their color-pencil texture. Every scene is a side view facing right, toy cloud or block targets with no violence or blood. Keep character, weapon and impact all clearly readable.
The latest user REJECTED using crescent effects for every weapon. This board must have FOUR very different silhouettes and motions, no crescent or C-shaped slash at all. Effects remain close to the weapon, not flying projectiles. Small grey directional arrows may explain movement.
Top left label “唐刀｜斜劈”. Pose: forward step, straight single-edged Tang dao cutting diagonally down. Effect: ONE short wide WHITE AND BLUE STRAIGHT DRY-BRUSH SLASH, a tapered diagonal streak from upper left to lower right, NOT a curved moon. Show one cloud target being clipped, small square impact chips. Caption “近距离 / 斜向劈砍”.
Top right label “火尖枪｜一点直刺”. Girl thrusts a long red spear horizontally. Effect: a THIN STRAIGHT ORANGE FIRE LINE hugging the shaft and a small DIAMOND SHAPED BURST at the tip; no crescent. Exactly TWO small wind-fire wheels under her feet, not flying away. Caption “距离最远 / 上下很窄”.
Bottom left label “青锋剑｜交叉快斩”. Girl holding the straight double-edged green-hilt sword. Effect: TWO SLENDER GREEN-WHITE STRAIGHT STROKES intersecting as an X, close in front of her. One faded stroke and one solid stroke show a quick sequential pair, one small target. Do not show extra weapons. Caption “短距离 / 两次交叉”.
Bottom right label “方天戟｜横扫宽带”. Girl braces both hands on the long halberd. Effect: LOW BROAD HORIZONTAL BLUE-GREY DRY-BRUSH WIND RIBBONS across two nearby targets at the same height, straight streaks like a broom sweep, no crescent. Show a faint ghosted weapon position to imply a sweep. Caption “横向范围大 / 收招较慢”.
Stay playful, simple and faithful to the child's drawing. Accurate gripping at the hilt or shaft, no detached arms. Character should occupy about one third of each scene width; full feet and effects visible. White/light colors must have colored pencil edges for visibility. Avoid overly rendered gradients, 3D, neon glow, cinematic backgrounds or excessive UI text.
items.correctionPrompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. Edit the attached board 利落招式, preserve its exact landscape dimensions, Chinese text, four panels, weapons, all attack effect shapes, crayon texture, characters, targets and layout. ONLY fix the footwear: remove the orange wind-fire wheels completely from the TOP LEFT Tang dao panel, BOTTOM LEFT jian panel, and BOTTOM RIGHT halberd panel. Replace each of those six wheels with a simple black crayon foot at the end of its existing stick leg standing on the ground; no circle, flames, rollers, wheels or trailing marks near those feet. Keep the TWO wind-fire wheels unchanged ONLY in the TOP RIGHT 火尖枪 spear panel. All non-spear panels must have ordinary black feet. Do not change anything else, do not redraw the board.

items.prompt:
Create one production-quality game combat concept board representing a single coherent direction titled “连段节奏”. Target dimensions 1440 x 1024 landscape. Exactly four spacious demonstrations in a 2 by 2 layout on light drawing paper, with thin colored-pencil dividers and readable Chinese labels. No option numbers or letters, no app chrome, no feature inventory. A clear visual hierarchy with a title, large action illustrations and one short caption per weapon.
Attach references are the real project art. Reference 1 is the SAME red-dress girl to use in ALL FOUR demonstrations: preserve her child's drawing identity, smiling white face, black chunky crayon outlines, curled twin pigtails, red triangular dress and stick limbs. Repose her arms and feet appropriately. Reference 2 straight single-edge Tang dao, 3 red fire-tip spear, 4 straight green-hilt jian, 5 long Chinese halberd; wind-fire wheels should be small orange-gold crayon wheels beneath the feet. Keep their recognizable silhouettes and hand-drawn texture. Side-view character faces right, with friendly training block/cloud targets.
User wants weapon attacks to have visibly different shapes and coverage, not four recolored crescents. NO CRESCENT SLASHES, no moon shapes anywhere among the effects. This direction is about differing motion rhythm and attack height, not bigger magic projectiles. All attack energy remains attached to the weapon's close-range action.
Top left: “唐刀｜上挑竖斩”. Show a short upward cut, girl lifting the straight Tang dao from low to high. Effect is a TALL VERTICAL BLUE-WHITE CHISEL-LIKE BRUSH MARK, with tapered angular corners and a small impact at its top. A target above a small ledge makes the high coverage obvious. Two subtle ghost positions show low-to-high movement. Caption “从下往上 / 对付高处”.
Top right: “火尖枪｜螺旋钻刺”. A forward spear thrust; effect is an ORANGE TAPERING CORKSCREW/HELIX of fire tightly wrapped around the last part of the spear shaft and tip, like a small pointed drill, never a crescent. Keep it narrow and close to the tip. Exactly two wind-fire wheels below the girl's feet. Caption “持续顶住前方 / 侧面较弱”.
Bottom left: “青锋剑｜三点连刺”. A fine straight jian rapidly thrusts the same close target three times. Three tiny separate GREEN-WHITE DIAMOND IMPACT POINTS, staggered slightly in height, and very thin horizontal motion marks. One real sword and faint ghost tip positions, not three floating swords. No X, no arcs, no crescent. Caption “三个落点 / 紧凑连击”.
Bottom right: “方天戟｜下砸震地”. Girl brings halberd down onto ground in front. Effect is a broad GOLDEN/BLUE-GREY JAGGED TRIANGULAR GROUND BURST, short angular dust spikes spreading left and right from the impact along the ground. A low target on each side of the impact, target above remains unaffected. No crater or damage to the level, no blood. Caption “贴地扩散 / 高处打不到”.
Use wide whitespace, small restrained direction arrows, expressive but childlike stick-figure movement. Every body, both feet, full weapon and whole effect fit the panel. Preserve rough crayon/pencil grain, no anime redesign, no 3D, no neon effects, no elaborate backgrounds. The four silhouettes must be instantly distinguishable: vertical stroke, helix, three points, ground spikes.

items.prompt:
Create a polished game-art design proposal sheet, one cohesive direction titled “彩笔奇招”. Target dimensions 1440 x 1024 landscape. The same established child's crayon art, four generous demonstration scenes in a 2 by 2 comparison board on off-white paper. Readable Chinese titles/captions, a few pencil direction arrows, no letters or option numbers. Avoid software chrome, rounded cards within cards and unrelated controls.
Reference 1 defines the SAME red-dress girl in every demonstration: thick black crayon outlines, white smiling face, two black curled pigtails, red triangle dress, thin stick arms and legs. Preserve that drawing identity faithfully, adapting the attack poses. References 2–5 define the exact Chinese Tang dao, fire-tip spear, straight jian, and halberd. Wind-fire wheels are small orange-gold crayon wheels beneath the feet. Keep the simple weapons' recognisable shapes and crayon texture. No generic anime child, armor or costume changes.
This design explores more imaginative attack SHAPES and COVERAGE. The user explicitly rejected four similar crescent slash effects. Absolutely NO MOON/CRESCENT/C-SHAPED weapon effect. Each weapon has a unique geometry, not a shared trail recolored. Effects remain attached to the weapon's close melee reach, no travelling projectiles, no homing, no detached lasers.
Top left title “唐刀｜回身双斩”. Girl midway through a turn, one actual straight dao, one faint previous pose. Two distinct tapered angular white-blue slash marks: one short strike behind the girl and a longer diagonal stroke in front, with a toy target on either side. These are STRAIGHT FACETED BRUSH MARKS like two separate bold dashes, not crescent arcs. Caption “前后都顾到 / 单侧较短”.
Top right “火尖枪｜火花扇刺”. Girl lunges with fire spear; at its tip THREE SHORT STRAIGHT ORANGE BRUSH RAYS fan out narrowly (upward, straight, downward) to illustrate three close thrust directions. Three tiny triangular sparks at ray tips. Ray origins must clearly attach to spear tip, not fly free. Exactly TWO wind-fire wheels underneath feet. Caption “前方三条线 / 比直刺更宽”.
Bottom left “青锋剑｜折线连斩”. Girl performs quick changes of sword direction. The green-white trail is a LIGHTNING-LIKE ZIGZAG Z, made of exactly three thin straight segments occupying a compact region in front, with subtle dot accents at the two corners. One green-hilt jian and one small target, never a crescent or X. Caption “上中下切换 / 短距离”.
Bottom right “方天戟｜风车转戟”. Girl spins the halberd head in a localized zone in front of her using the long shaft. Effect is FOUR BROAD SLATE-BLUE DRY-BRUSH SPOKES like a simple pinwheel, centered around the halberd head; a translucent four-blade wind fan showing upper and lower coverage. Not a solid circle, not a crescent, not a sawblade, and not a projectile. Two soft toy targets at different heights in front. Caption “上下覆盖大 / 留出起手”.
Use children's paper-and-crayon aesthetics with irregular black contour, restrained saturated colored accents, visible chalk grain, readable drawings and plenty of white space. Draw honest hand-to-weapon contact. All limbs, weapons, targets and effects must fit comfortably. No blood, violent impact, scary faces, 3D rendering or glossy neon glow.
